about: The cut hint (Dom 2026-10-28: #219's select + Take UI is out; the corpse works as before, a tap on a part cuts it and the part lands on the ground). What stays is #219's small bobbing yellow arrow with ONE short line of small caps above the corpse (src/fight/pickup.ts validatePickup checks the values). PRESENTATION ONLY and DOM: pointer-events none, never touches the sim, the camera or the input. `on`/`query`/`off`: ?pickup=v1 hides it. `text.label`: the one line (Dom's final wording: Strike to dismember, which reads right for a tap and a click). `units`: the cut units a corpse must still have one of for the hint to show (the physics.json cut.cue units). `delayS`: seconds the corpse must have been frozen first. `hintSeconds`: it goes this long after it appears. It also goes at the first cut made while it shows. `walkAwayM`: it hides when the hero is further than this from the corpse. `arrow.liftPx`: the arrow's tip above the corpse's hips. `safe`: the box the arrow and line stay in, as fractions of the viewport, so they never sit on the thumb controls or the HUD bars.
